verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a local HTTP APIs server for external access to the graph and a plugin API (community-maintained docs) plus a logseq:// URL protocol for third-party invocation, giving AI tools a documented path to read/write data. However, probes show no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and a community comment notes losing the ability to script Claude/codex against the new DB version, suggesting inconsistent/fragile API support. Missing for 10: formal OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, confirmed stable AI-agent integration across versions, independent hands-on API usage reports.
